title: Half Day LA Tour: Hollywood, Celebrity Homes, Santa Monica
blurb:
Explore the iconic sights of Los Angeles on this 4.5-hour tour from Hollywood to Santa Monica. Experience the glamour of Beverly Hills, snap photos at the Hollywood Sign, and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of Santa Monica Pier. You’ll see famed locations like Hollywood Walk of Fame, Melrose Avenue, Sunset Strip, West Hollywood, UCLA, Beverly Hills, Santa Monica Pier, Hollywood Hills... all while learning fun facts from your knowledgeable guide. Perfect for first-time visitors and seasoned travelers alike, this small-group tour ensures a personalized experience of LA’s top highlights.

- Duration: 4.5 hours with 3 iconic stops
- Small group tour with a capacity of up to 18 guests
- Visit famous locations: Beverly Hills & Rodeo Drive, Santa Monica Pier and Hollywood Sign Overlook
- Bonus: See real celebrity homes like Michael Jackson, Adele, Quentin Tarantino and iconic film locations featured in E.T., Fast & Furious, Back to the Future, and more
